## 📌 Data Correction Type
Please select one or more:
- [ ] Inaccurate POI Coordinates (Latitude / Longitude)
- [ ] Missing Convenience Store / Cooling Shelter (7-Eleven, FamilyMart, Cactus Ice Shop)
- [ ] Incorrect POI Name or Missing Bilingual Translation (Mandarin / English)
- [ ] Outdated Ferry Schedule or Ticket Information (`penghu_ferry_routes.json`)
- [ ] Broken or Incorrect Wikipedia Reference / Image Link

## 🗺️ Affected Node / Entity
* **Node ID or Name**: (e.g. `OSM_node_123456` or `通梁古榕 / Tongliang Great Banyan`)
* **Current Coordinates**: Lat: `...`, Lon: `...`
* **Current Island / Region**: (e.g. Magong, Xiyu, Baisha, Huxi, Qimei, Wang'an)

## ✅ Corrected Information
* **Correct Name (Mandarin / English)**:
* **Verified Coordinates**: Lat: `...`, Lon: `...`
* **Category / Amenities**: (e.g. 24h AC, Water Refill, Restroom, Scooter Parking)
* **Verification Reference / Source**: (e.g. Google Maps link, Taiwan Tourism Administration registry, official ferry operator notice)
